Try as she might, Rin Rokuhara couldn’t turn her brain off. She couldn’t even come close.
Because Chika was right — this was like a dream come true. But it was a dream she dreamt long ago, before someone else began to take her place.
And yes, there were scattered fantasies here and there that’d pop up out of nowhere. Chika was still Rin’s type, after all. She was always going to think things.
But she’d settled into her role as a good friend. A potential lover who never struck when the iron was hot enough.
But now she was the one being struck, and she couldn’t tell if she was high on the sensation or delirious from blunt force trauma.

Was this Chika at all? Or was it someone she didn’t know?
